body:
**DM-272 attempt 2 (fix round): new tests and mutation record** (adds to cm_01m7javpbf8sy5xnm3bqtqgnwk and cm_01m7javqfy563hfr8tazsqrcqe)

1. Fireguard empty-test: drafts.personEstimate.test.ts: each refusal test asserts `expect(refusalOf(...)).toEqual(UNCHANGED)` in its own callback. scratch/DM-272/ast-check.ts runs Fireguard's analyzeTestSource on all 33 new/touched test files: no empty tests, tautologies or mock-heavy files. Mutation: guard `role === 'desktop'` -> `!== 'nobody'` fails all 3 refusal tests; restored.
2. Flake: TicketPanel.test.tsx Definition of Done tests wait for the loaded checks/evidence (findByRole group 'api', findAllByRole listitem, findByText 'PASSED', findByText 'This project has no Definition of Done.'). Old file under 7 parallel shuffled runs x3: 5 of 21 failed ('lists the project Definition of Done…', 'in a folder of repositories…'); new file: 105 of 105 runs passed (35 + 70, 7 parallel, shuffled seeds).
3. Unpinned branches (each mutation fails the named test; restored):
- reportScorecardView.ts › 'DM-182 c2: a run sum never reads a missing run as 0': :377 measures.length===0 -> ===-1 fails 'reads unavailable when no run executed work'; :382 missing!==undefined -> ===null fails 'reads unavailable with the reason when one run has no number, beside one that has'; :387 estimated -> false fails 'marks a sum over runs as estimated when one run's number is'.
- epicScorecardView.ts › 'DM-181 c3: nothing missing ever reads as 0': :269 fails 'reads a total with no run's usage as unavailable, naming every run, never "≥ 0"'; :390 fails 'reads the active clock as unavailable when no run measured any activity'; :420 fails 'reads a frozen quantity still open at the report but with no number as unavailable, not "≥ 0"'.
- WorkspaceHeader.tsx › 'DM-191 review fix: the source lookup asks only usable folders, once, and only while the epic is shown': :104 initialized/available checks dropped fail 'never asks a folder that is not set up or not available'; :137 mounted check dropped fails 'a lookup that finishes after the epic was left does not navigate'; :143 disabled dropped fails 'the link is disabled and busy while it looks, and a second click asks nothing more' (aria-busy added).
- MetricsDashboard.tsx › 'DM-267 c2: a failed Refresh keeps the data it read': :47 alert hidden with data, :103 refreshError null, :104 data dropped on error each fail 'shows the old values beside the refresh error, then a Refresh that succeeds replaces them and clears it'.
- CorrectivePlanner.tsx › 'DM-187 c2 (completed epic): …' (rig epicCompleted set): :776 FollowUpTarget replaced fails 'offers a follow-up epic title instead of any sprint of the draft, and sends the trimmed title'; :144 title '' fails the same; :90 scopeOf epicCompleted false fails it and 'drops a sprint chosen before the epic completed, says why…'; :667 guard dropped fails 'reads work already held in the completed epic itself as nothing added, without the checkpoint-gate hint'. Also 'creates into the follow-up epic and opens it there, with no checkpoint-gate hint'.
4. Fixtures: src/test/scorecardWorldRecorder.ts (built on src/test/spaceWorld.ts; in-memory repository, test clock and ids; rerun `npx tsx src/test/recordScorecardWorlds.ts`, deterministic: identical md5 over two runs) writes one pretty-printed file per world under src/renderer/src/__mocks__/scorecardWorlds/ (epicActive, epicCompleted, reportApproved, reportCheckout, reportLive, reportEmpty). epicLegacy dropped. __mocks__/scorecardWorlds.ts validates each file with a zod RecordingSchema (no `as` casts). Drift check src/test/scorecardWorldRecorder.test.ts › 'DM-272: the recorded Scorecard worlds match the core read models' › 'records every world afresh with the same commands, inputs and output shapes as the checked-in files' and › 'reports a field the core no longer returns, one it added and a changed kind'. scratch/DM-265/world.ts:1 comment fixed.
